caveats: Adkins v. Fields, E.D. Ky. No. 7:22-CV-7-REW, filed January 31, 2022 by Sabrina Adkins and the Estate of Jennifer Hill against former deputy/court security officer Ben Fields, the Letcher County Sheriff (originally Mickey Stines, later Billy Jones in official capacity), and Eastern Kentucky Correctional Services. Fields coerced Adkins, a civilian on home incarceration, into sex acts (often in Judge Kevin Mullins' courthouse chambers). Hill's claims were dismissed as time-barred; Adkins' surviving claims settled in March 2026 during jury selection, terms not disclosed, so settlement amount is null. Fields pleaded guilty in the criminal case to third-degree rape, third-degree sodomy, tampering with a prisoner monitoring device, and second-degree perjury (six months jail plus probation). Separately, Sheriff Stines is accused of fatally shooting Judge Mullins on Sept 19, 2024. Slug says 2024 but sources establish the civil suit was filed in 2022.
